sentences.en: In the hallway where the commotion had settled down, Amano quietly approached the patient who had been hesitant to discuss the costs.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.jp: サポートの制度があること、一人で抱え込む必要はないこと――彼女はそれを、いつもの穏やかな声で告げようとする。

sentences.en: She tries to convey, in her usual gentle voice, that there is a support system in place and that there is no need to bear it all alone.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.jp: 病院という場所が、ただ痛みを撮る場所ではなく、抱えている不安を降ろす場所であってほしい。

sentences.en: I hope that a hospital is not just a place to alleviate pain, but also a place to relieve the anxieties one carries.
sentences.speaker: narrator
